extension.description: Compare files in the standard VS Code diff editor while keeping L (left), R (right), file locations, copy direction, and the file being changed clear.
submenu.label: Easy Left Right Diff
view.leftRight.name: Easy Left Right Diff
configuration.title: Easy Left Right Diff
color.leftBadge.description: Identification color for the L (left) file.
color.rightBadge.description: Identification color for the R (right) file.
color.leftHighlight.description: Temporary highlight color for the L (left) file after revealing its location.
color.rightHighlight.description: Temporary highlight color for the R (right) file after revealing its location.
configuration.copyConfirmation.descripti: Details shown before copying a change. The default is a compact source, destination, and difference number summary.
configuration.copyConfirmation.enum.deta: Show source, destination, change type, nearby lines, and content.
configuration.copyConfirmation.enum.comp: Show source, destination, the file that will change, and the difference number.
configuration.autoReveal.description: How to reveal the L/R file location in the standard Explorer.
configuration.autoReveal.enum.button: Reveal only when the location button is used.
configuration.autoReveal.enum.activeSide: Reveal when the active side changes.
configuration.copyNotification.descripti: Also show copy completion briefly in the status bar in addition to the post-copy confirmation dialog.
configuration.restorePreviousSelection.d: Compatibility setting. The current behavior clears L/R when the diff closes and does not restore the previous L/R after restart.
configuration.recentComparisonLimit.desc: Number of recent comparisons to keep.

command.clearRight.title: Clear R (Right)

command.switchToNormal.title: Current: Read-only | Switch to Normal Comparison

command.showAddresses.title: Show L and R Addresses

command.endComparison.title: End Comparison
command.copyHunkLeftToRight.title: Copy Current Change from L (Left) to R (Right)
command.copyHunkRightToLeft.title: Copy Current Change from R (Right) to L (Left)
command.copyFileLeftToRight.title: Copy Entire L (Left) File to R (Right)
command.copyFileRightToLeft.title: Copy Entire R (Right) File to L (Left)

configuration.showParentFolderDecoration: Show subtle L/R badges on parent folders containing the selected files.
configuration.autoMoveAfterCopy.descript: Move to the next difference after keeping a copied change. Disabled by default.
configuration.warnWhenAutoSaveEnabled.de: Warn before starting a comparison when Auto Save is enabled.
configuration.unmanagedWarning.descripti: Controls warnings before writing to files that are not tracked by Git or whose Git state cannot be determined. Recovery snapshots are still created when warnings are disabled.
configuration.unmanagedWarning.enum.work: Warn only the first time in each workspace.
